tools.name: WinPEAS

tools.notice: Same PEASS license issue; enumerate potential paths, do not automatically exploit them. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds.

tools.name: Wireshark / TShark
tools.purpose: Inspect supplied captures and identify observed IT/OT conversations
tools.notice: GPL-2.0 family; preserve component notices. Dissector coverage is release dependent. Packet capture needs authorized placement and may contain secrets. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds.

tools.name: Zeek
tools.purpose: Turn captures into connection/protocol metadata and support asset hypotheses
tools.notice: BSD-style; plugins have their own provenance. Do not assume complete vendor/OT coverage. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds.

tools.name: Suricata
tools.purpose: Offline protocol/event analysis as an alternative or complement to Zeek
tools.notice: GPL-2.0 family; rules have separate licenses. Use offline/IDS profile; do not deploy inline IPS in the initial kit. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds. tools.name: Scapy
tools.purpose: Flexible packet parsing and synthetic protocol fixtures when a full product is unnecessary
tools.notice: GPL-2.0 family. Restrict initial helpers to offline parsing; raw packet generation is a separate reviewed use. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds.

tools.name: enum4linux-ng
tools.purpose: Windows/Samba inventory if business systems or file shares are in scope
tools.notice: GPL-3.0. Authentication/enumeration creates traffic; distinguish access denial from absent assets. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds.

tools.name: NetExec
tools.purpose: Scope-limited Windows/network service assessment and inventory
tools.notice: BSD-2-Clause; modules/dependencies reviewed individually. No spraying, remote execution or bulk modules in default profiles. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds.

tools.name: Impacket
tools.purpose: SMB/MSRPC/Kerberos protocol helpers for the IT side of an engagement
tools.notice: Slightly modified Apache Software License, per upstream. Do not relabel Apache-2.0; select exact examples and review terms/dependencies. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds.

tools.name: testssl.sh
tools.purpose: TLS configuration review of approved web consoles, remote access or APIs
tools.notice: GPL-2.0. Many handshakes/probes; choose bounded checks and account for fragile embedded endpoints. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds.

tools.name: ffuf
tools.purpose: Limited web content discovery on an explicitly approved portal
tools.notice: MIT. Request generation/fuzzing is not a default OT operation; require explicit endpoint and budget. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds.

tools.name: Metasploit Framework
tools.purpose: Known module research and controlled lab reproduction; possible scoped IT checks
tools.notice: BSD-style core with component terms. Module/source review required; no blanket ICS exploitation profile. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds.

tools.name: PyModbus
tools.purpose: Modbus TCP/serial clients and synthetic server/simulator; possible pump, meter or environmental controller interfaces
tools.notice: BSD-3-Clause-style terms. Upstream warns of API changes and limited nonstandard-device support. No arbitrary register sweeps. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds.

tools.name: mbpoll
tools.purpose: Convenient Modbus TCP/RTU command-line checks
tools.notice: GPL-3.0. Document selected major branch, finite polling, unit/address/type and no-write invocation. Distinct from proprietary modpoll. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds.

tools.name: libmodbus
tools.purpose: C backend/alternative for Modbus TCP and RTU helpers
tools.notice: LGPL-2.1-or-later. Useful backend, not another mandatory CLI; avoid duplicate implementations without need. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds.

tools.name: MinimalModbus
tools.purpose: Modbus RTU/ASCII instrument access where serial-only needs justify it
tools.notice: Apache-2.0. Not a Modbus TCP replacement. Wiring, serial settings and physical access are prerequisites. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds.

tools.name: python-snap7
tools.purpose: Siemens S7 communication and controlled simulator/metadata work if relevant
tools.notice: MIT. Current README describes pure Python and model/access limits; older releases may differ. Do not enable PUT/GET or change controller settings to make a test work. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds.

tools.name: cpppo
tools.purpose: EtherNet/IP CIP client/server and synthetic fixtures
tools.notice: GPL-3 with stated exceptions/alternative terms. Use GPL route consistently; choose bounded identity/read operations, not arbitrary CIP services. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds.

tools.name: pycomm3
tools.purpose: Allen-Bradley/Rockwell-specific EtherNet/IP option
tools.notice: MIT. Upstream explicitly says no longer actively developed. Keep as documented fallback; do not default-stage without ownership and compatibility evidence. Acquisition does not resolve operational or output-integration holds.

spec.reason: Existing project maintenance hold on pycomm3 remains unresolved.

tools.name: asyncua / opcua-asyncio
tools.purpose: OPC UA client/server, namespace inspection and security-mode evaluation

tools.name: open62541
